pr_title: Cancel entity timers during modbus shutdown
pr_body:

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
It seems docker images handles timers differently, than hass on a raspberry pi or Mac where they are stopped when HA starts a shutdown.

In order to prevent further modbus activity after event EVENT_HOMEASSISTANT_STOP is received, this PR calls the listener_cancel for each active timer.

review_comments: We shouldn't define mutable objects as class attributes since they will be mutated by every instance of the class. Usually that's a bug and not intended.
It is actually indented, but I will move it to init.
